title: Post-Paper-1 one-cycle flywheel relay: operation-policy transfer before the rank pyramid
summary: Define the bounded successor to frozen Paper 1, without changing or delaying its prompted Dream-LoRA-Think closure. Instead of making PCFL V3/PCFL-lite a prerequisite for learned control, the successor begins with one causal relay inside the eventual lifetime harness. The smallest world delta is a v03r active-action projection: withhold one decisive intervention effect, let the controller choose and execute one public intervention, compile its outcome, reset working context, and require a later legal COMMIT. A shared frozen LOOP LoRA is trained only on verified public operation traces from disjoint source worlds. Whole-life extension is conditional. Rank pyramids, weight merging, base promotion, model-owned dreaming, and all frozen Paper-1 claims remain deferred or unchanged.
system_thesis: The deadline-critical unknown is whether learned experience can alter how an agent gathers evidence and thereby improve what it can learn next. The smallest faithful test is a complete action-to-experience-to-memory-to-later-action relay, with reusable operation policy separated from life-local factual memory and with wrong-life, binding, prompt/skill, trajectory-SFT, raw-memory, shortcut, and reset controls.

nodes.before: Repair and implement the full PCFL Active Stream V3 protocol before any lifetime or LOOP-policy successor study.
nodes.rationale: It would certify a finite text-memory protocol without measuring learned operation transfer or the flywheel. This removal does not change the frozen Paper-1 prompted-organism path.

nodes.after: A minimal active-action projection of lands/v03r with disjoint source, DEV, and untouched TEST world roots: one decisive intervention-effect row is withheld; the controller receives several type-correct valve/target interventions, executes exactly one, observes only its ordinary public CHANGE/STABLE consequence, and later issues a typed legal COMMIT whose payload is scored by the environment. The required valve is not named in the goal and unchanged Action World v0 is only a legal-action regression fixture.
nodes.rationale: v03r already supplies collision twins, dispersed causal edges, recurrence, and shortcut audits; the projection adds the missing learn-more-then-act relay without a new semantic-world rewrite. Unchanged Action World has no nontrivial information-action choice because its generic cautious policy is already perfect.

nodes.after: Target-masked training rows of PUBLIC_STATE, legal menu, bounded memory return, and NEXT_LEGAL_OPERATION from verified source-world trajectories; no rationale, hidden proof, future outcome, score, evaluation identity, or target allocation.
nodes.rationale: This isolates a reusable operation disposition from life-specific content and avoids training on noisy raw trajectories.

nodes.after: One small operation-target LoRA trained across source worlds, frozen before evaluation, mounted read-only in unseen lives, and never merged with life memory or base weights.
nodes.rationale: This is the minimum test of the LoRA-as-agency intuition without presupposing a rank hierarchy.

nodes.after: A life-local store containing only supported one-edge facts mechanically compiled from that life's earlier public action/outcome events; text is primary and an identical-corpus MEMORY LoRA is conditional.
nodes.rationale: Exact evidence must remain distinct from the shared policy and must reset between lives.

nodes.after: At byte-identical public states, randomized controller assignment selects a legal query/probe/backtrack/write/act/defer/stop operation while all life facts, budgets, prompt bytes, RNG namespace, and public state are held fixed.
nodes.rationale: The first causal link is a change in what evidence the agent chooses to acquire.

nodes.after: The chosen legal action yields one ordinary public outcome that is appended and deterministically compiled into a supported local fact before a short-context reset.
nodes.rationale: The operation shift must create genuinely new usable experience, not just an answer or judge label.

nodes.after: A fresh later goal requires joining an old life relation with the newly acquired relation; success, return, regret, evidence use, and resource cost are scored only after the trace seals.
nodes.rationale: This closes one full learning relay at a behavioral endpoint.

nodes.after: Only after the relay passes on DEV, extend the same harness to early/middle/late unique causal cohorts; only after text passes, compare the exact same admitted corpus as text versus a fresh per-life MEMORY LoRA.
nodes.rationale: Sequential gates spend model/GPU compute on the next live uncertainty and do not let LoRA rescue an invalid world or controller.

edges.after: Verified source-world public operation transitions are projected with all hidden and future descendants removed.
edges.rationale: Across-life policy training must use lawful public inputs and legal operation targets.

edges.after: Behavior cloning trains only operation-family and public-argument tokens; the adapter freezes before unseen lives.
edges.rationale: This makes the learned object an operation prior rather than a fact store.

edges.after: Randomized read-only assignment may change legal operation logits and the selected public information action.
edges.rationale: Cloned states identify whether the policy adapter changes evidence acquisition.

edges.after: Only the executed action's ordinary public result may enter life-local compilation.
edges.rationale: No counterfactual verifier or hidden oracle sits in the cognitive loop.

edges.after: The deterministic target-blind compiler adds a supported one-edge atom with provenance.
edges.rationale: This is the within-life learning step.

edges.after: Bounded adaptive reads expose local atoms to the recurrent controller after context reset.
edges.rationale: Wrong-life and binding interventions can now falsify experiential attribution.

edges.after: Only a predeclared positive DEV relay unlocks whole-life text evaluation; only successful text lifetime unlocks MEMORY-LoRA transport.
edges.rationale: The experiment advances by causal-link gates rather than by optimism or larger models.

loops.after: Train a single small shared LOOP adapter on balanced verified public operation transitions from source worlds; compare base, bounded prompt/skill, and matched ordinary trajectory SFT on whole unseen DEV worlds.
loops.trigger: The CPU world, shortcut, taint, reset, and corpus gates pass and source/DEV/TEST roots are sealed.
loops.stop_condition: Freeze one predeclared rank after the allowed DEV installation check, or stop if prompt/skill or trajectory SFT matches the operation-transfer criterion.
loops.rationale: It tests policy transfer before any rank pyramid or life-memory LoRA.

loops.after: At a cloned uncertainty state, choose one information action, observe its public result, compile it into isolated life memory, reset working context, and solve a later goal requiring old plus new relations.
loops.trigger: A frozen controller assignment and authentic or falsified life-memory assignment are installed on a DEV world.
loops.stop_condition: Stop at later action success/failure or the predeclared operation/action budget; any taint or reset failure invalidates the cell.
loops.rationale: This is the minimum complete action-to-better-action flywheel relay.

loops.after: Run the same controller and compiler at early, middle, and late checkpoints with increasing unique causal cohorts and new, old, and cross-era goals; evaluation is sterile.
loops.trigger: Every DEV world passes both diagnostic evidence acquisition and later-action relay thresholds under authentic memory.
loops.stop_condition: Stop if gains are only early, only recall, only added compute, renderer-specific, or absent against the strongest native explicit-memory baseline.
loops.rationale: This begins measuring development without creating a second benchmark project.

loops.after: Train one fresh per-life MEMORY LoRA on exactly the supported corpus used by text, keep it separate from the frozen LOOP adapter, and rerun the same later-action cells plus direct-QA and wrong-life controls.
loops.trigger: The text-memory whole-life gate passes with a frozen corpus and reader contract.
loops.stop_condition: Stop without rescue if fixed-read fidelity is below 0.90 or action value is more than 0.10 below text; never merge ranks or adapters.
loops.rationale: LoRA is tested as transport only after the cognitive and developmental links work.

claims.before: A complete standalone PCFL V3 or PCFL-lite protocol must precede any lifetime or LOOP-policy experiment.
claims.after: PCFL controls are inherited selectively inside the one-cycle lifetime harness; standalone PCFL completion is deferred.
claims.evidence_needed: Architecture consensus that the relay retains target embargo, whole-world splits, action endpoints, wrong-life/binding controls, reset, and complete traces without the V3 runtime superstructure.

claims.after: On untouched synthetic world-lives, a frozen across-life operation adapter changed information-seeking behavior beyond frozen base, bounded prompt/skill, and matched trajectory-SFT controls.
claims.evidence_needed: Whole-world held-out cloned-state operation distributions and executed diagnostic actions with renaming/counterfactual controls, complete failures, and a predeclared margin over the strongest control.

claims.after: The policy-caused public experience was admitted into isolated life memory and improved a later held-out legal action that depended on authentic old plus new relations.
claims.evidence_needed: Operation shift, information gain, target-blind compilation, post-reset path use, later action gain, and loss of at least half the gain under wrong-life/binding memory on untouched world-lives.

claims.after: Across early, middle, and late checkpoints with increasing unique causal cohorts, the learned-operation condition improved later-life action more than the strongest baseline while retaining old and cross-era goals.
claims.evidence_needed: Presealed whole-world lifetime curves with new/old/cross-era action endpoints, strong native baselines, resource curves, all failures, and confirmation beyond the pilot.

claims.after: The exact supported life corpus retained its bounded action value when moved from explicit text to a fresh isolated per-life MEMORY LoRA.
claims.evidence_needed: Same admitted corpus, fixed-read fidelity at least 0.90, action noninferiority tolerance 0.10, direct-QA LoRA, wrong-life controls, fresh resets, and independent review.

claims.before: LoRA-as-procedure has no context-window equivalent at any scale.
claims.after: A learned adapter may provide a reusable amortized operation prior under fixed decision-context, latency, and token budgets; prompts, skills, and trajectory SFT remain explicit alternative explanations.
claims.evidence_needed: Matched prompt/skill and trajectory-SFT baselines plus held-out operation and action transfer.

claims.before: Rank grows automatically with accumulated verified data and implements learning timescale.
claims.after: A rank/data/update-timescale cascade is an untested successor hypothesis and receives no Paper-1 evidence or implementation until a single fixed-rank LOOP adapter transfers and improves action.
claims.evidence_needed: Separate future design controlling rank, verified data, optimizer state, update cadence, replay, decay, and promotion mechanism.

acceptance_tests.setup: On sealed CPU qualification roots, compare exact-memory recurrent, exact no-lifetime adaptive, authentic life memory, wrong-life, and binding-shuffled controllers at the later legal-action endpoint.
acceptance_tests.expected: Oracle value >=0.85; no-lifetime <=0.35; authentic gain >=0.30; each falsified memory removes at least half the gain and >=0.15 absolute.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The world does not require authentic acquired experience or has inadequate headroom.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run target-only, current-state-only, renderer/ID/position, fixed-operation, relabel/rerender, deterministic replay, and direct-record-closure audits on whole held-out CPU roots.
acceptance_tests.expected: Shortcut policies <=0.35; correct action is render invariant; no one public record closes the later target; replay bytes and outcomes are exact.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The relay can be solved without the intended learned path or is nondeterministic.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate hidden proof, future result, scorer, target allocation, arm label, prior-life canary, cache, optimizer, and evaluation outcome fields across every declared interface.
acceptance_tests.expected: All forbidden descendants are rejected or leave model-visible/training bytes invariant; fresh life state hashes differ appropriately and old canaries are unreachable; evaluation cannot update later state.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Attribution is contaminated or lives are not isolated.

acceptance_tests.setup: Build the source-world operation corpus and independently inspect exact rows, split lineage, masks, balance, public arguments, and handle/renderer/world-ID predictability.
acceptance_tests.expected: Rows contain only public pre-operation state, legal menu, bounded memory return, and next legal operation; no test bytes influence selection; at least query and backtrack motifs survive; shortcut decoders remain at the frozen ceiling.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The LOOP target is answer-bearing, future-conditioned, or a superficial identifier task.

acceptance_tests.setup: At cloned unseen DEV states compare P-BASE, bounded P-TEXT/P-SKILL, matched trajectory SFT, authentic P-LOOP, and policy/handle/binding shuffles with fixed public bytes and budgets.
acceptance_tests.expected: P-LOOP improves diagnostic-operation rate by >=0.10 over the strongest frozen control on every DEV world, survives renaming/counterfactual skins, and does not decode life/world content above null.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The adapter does not transfer a reusable operation disposition or ordinary prompting/SFT explains it.

acceptance_tests.setup: Randomize P-BASE/P-LOOP and authentic/wrong/binding memory at cloned DEV states; execute one discriminating action, compile its public outcome, reset working context, and execute the later legal goal.
acceptance_tests.expected: P-LOOP improves diagnostic evidence acquisition and later action value by >=0.10 over the strongest controller under authentic memory; the new atom is used; wrong/binding memory removes at least half the gain and >=0.15; every DEV world has the favorable sign.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A learned operation shift does not close the action-experience-memory-action loop.

acceptance_tests.setup: Conditionally run early/middle/late unique causal cohorts with new, old, and cross-era legal goals against the strongest controller and native explicit-memory baselines.
acceptance_tests.expected: Late P-LOOP action advantage >=0.10; its early-to-late improvement exceeds the strongest baseline by >=0.10; old value falls <=0.10; new and cross-era signs are favorable; all compute is reported.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The gain is not developmental, is recall-only, or is purchased by unbounded hidden work.

acceptance_tests.setup: Conditionally compare identical admitted life corpus as M-TEXT versus a fresh M-LORA under frozen P-LOOP, direct-QA LoRA, and wrong-life controls.
acceptance_tests.expected: Fixed-read fidelity >=0.90; M-LORA action value >= M-TEXT-0.10; wrong-life removes the registered gain; direct-QA does not erase any claimed compilation advantage.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Parametric life-memory transport is not faithful or compilation adds no value at this scale.

acceptance_tests.setup: After all DEV bytes freeze, run four untouched whole world-lives across three checkpoints with the smallest complete controller/memory roster and every failure in the denominator.
acceptance_tests.expected: Mean late P-LOOP gain >=0.10; at least 3/4 lives favorable; developmental difference >=0.10; all cohorts favorable; falsified memory removes at least half and >=0.15.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The effect does not survive whole-world transfer; the pilot remains nonconfirmatory regardless of sign.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh independent reviewer audits the frozen implementation, world split, corpus, traces, result analysis, and all failed cells while an author-side scientific advocate separately maps evidence to each claim.
acceptance_tests.expected: Reviewer approves with no required changes; advocate cannot override a rejection; GPU and claim scopes are exact and separately ratified.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The implementation or evidence cannot support the declared narrow conclusions.
